GeoDataSourceAPIKeyCredential.title: GeoDataSource API Key
GeoDataSourceAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste your GeoDataSource API key from your account. Location Search and Neighboring Countries are separate services; the key needs access to the service you use. NoClick sends it only to api.geodatasource.com. Connecting performs one nearest-city lookup and uses a lookup credit; it verifies key reachability, not account identity.
